en-US.name: Bill Payment Assistant
en-US.summary: Manage and pay your bills hands-free with voice commands. Get proactive reminders and make secure payments with OTP verification.
en-US.description:
Bill Payment Assistant helps you manage and pay your bills using natural voice commands through your Alexa device. Never miss a payment with proactive reminders for bills due within 7 days. Make secure payments hands-free with multi-factor authentication using OTP codes sent to your mobile phone.

Key Features:
- Get voice reminders for upcoming bills
- List all your unpaid bills
- Pay bills securely with OTP verification
- Check payment history and status
- Natural conversation flow with Alexa

To get started, enable the skill and link your account. You'll need to have bills set up in your account to use this service.

Security:
- All payments require OTP verification sent to your registered mobile number
- Secure OAuth 2.0 account linking
- Encrypted data storage and transmission
- No sensitive payment data stored

Privacy:
- Your data is encrypted and secure
- We only access data necessary for bill management
- See our privacy policy for details

publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
To test this skill:
1. Enable the skill in Alexa app
2. Link your account using OAuth 2.0
3. Ensure you have test bills in DynamoDB for your user_id
4. Test with: 'Alexa, open bill payment'
5. Test bill reminders: 'Alexa, what bills are due?'
6. Test payment flow: 'Alexa, pay my utility bill'
7. Test OTP verification by providing the OTP sent to your phone
8. Test help: 'Alexa, help'
9. Test cancellation: 'Alexa, cancel'

Test account credentials:
- User ID: test_user_123
- Phone: +1234567890 (for OTP testing)

Note: This is a test skill. Real payments are not processed.
